subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Vaska's complex（trans-IrCl(CO)(PPh₃)₂）？
A. Square planar
B. Tetrahedral
C. Octahedral
D. Trigonal bipyramidal
explanation: Square planar. Covalent count: Ir (group 9) 9 e; 1 × Cl (X) 1 e; 2 × PPh₃ (L) 4 e; 1 × CO (L) 2 e: 16 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −1 in all and the complex is neutral, so the metal is Ir(I), d⁸; d⁸ + 8 e from the ligands = 16 e. Adds H₂, O₂ or MeI by oxidative addition to give 18-electron Ir(III).
